purpose: High-precision private-organization scale-out from canonical State dossiers.
identityRule: Promote only a stable named private organization detected through high-signal corporate/vendor context. Generic contractor/supplier classes and product brands without an exact organization boundary remain unmaterialized.
explicitDeferrals: HTI private contractors are not named in the canonical State dossier, so no company identities are invented.
USA contractor/vendor classes are not promoted unless the State dossier or an already-curated organization record supplies a stable named referent.
Product names such as Pegasus and NoviSpy are not coerced into Organization identities; product/deployment projectization requires an exact reviewed object boundary.
explicitNonGoals: Do not infer that Cellebrite supplied, operated, controlled or materially participated in the Serbian project from identity alone.
Do not convert supplier remediation into a governance outcome.
Do not convert unnamed private-contractor classes into fabricated companies.
